subject: AuthZ regression: request to validate failure window and credit eligibility
messages:
From: Nicole Park <nicole.park@quartzpay.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Failed authorizations spike — seeing 502/500s for card auths (June 7 08:45–09:02 PT)

Sergio / Laura,

We saw a spike of failed authorizations this morning when processing live transactions. Between ~08:45–09:02 PT our payment gateway started returning 502/500 errors on authorization requests, which resulted in a ~3.7% auth failure increase for ~17 minutes. Ops flagged it and we reverted a routing change, which reduced the errors.

Can you confirm whether this is considered an availability regression on your side and whether QuartzPay is eligible under the contract for a pro‑rata credit? Finance will need the exact impacted window and the evidence bundle (logs/traces) to open our internal billing request.

I can share a short summary PDF if that helps.

Thanks,
Nicole Park
Head of Payments Operations
QuartzPay

Attachment: customer-snapshot-20270607.pdf (summary)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Park <nicole.park@quartzpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Failed authorizations spike — seeing 502/500s for card auths (June 7 08:45–09:02 PT)

Thanks Nicole — I appreciate the detailed window and the PDF.

Quick acknowledgement: we are opening an incident ticket on our side and will pull the router + auth service logs for the 08:30–09:10 PT window you provided. I will confirm whether this meets the SLO definition for "service availability" under section 4.1 of our MSA and, if eligible, provide a pro‑rata credit calculation and supporting evidence.

Next steps from our side:
- Internal evidence pull and initial timeline by 11:30 PT today (Marissa, can you own?)
- Initial impact confirmation and whether this meets SLO criteria by EOD PT
- If eligible, provide calculation and a sanitized log bundle for Finance.

Nicole — I'll send a dedicated follow up with the exact timestamps we validate and the proposed remediation offer.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: QuartzPay authz spike — evidence pull & SLO check

Marissa / Laura — looping you in to validate the customer window and to coordinate evidence. Important constraints:
- Customer reports errors 08:45–09:02 PT; include a 15min buffer either side for prefix caching or clock skew.
- Need to determine whether the failure mode maps to our Availability SLO (5xx responses on inference/authorization path) or whether it's upstream (partner gateway).
- If we deem it our SLO, estimate pro‑rata credit and get a sanitized log bundle for QuartzPay Finance.

Marissa — please pull: router access logs, auth‑service stderr/stdout, KV cache hit ratios, and autoscaler events for 08:30–09:15 PT (PT timezone). Zip and redact any PII. Indicate any rollout activity in the cluster at that time.

Laura — please advise on contract interpretation (MSA sec 4.1/4.3) and whether a 17min impact typically clears eligibility. If you think we need legal to sign off, flag asap.

I'll stay on this thread and coordinate outbound comms.
Sergio
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: QuartzPay authz spike — evidence pull & SLO check

Quick update — evidence bundle is ready and attached. Summary:
- Router 503/502 spike begins at 08:46:12 PT, peaks at 08:51:30 PT, and returns to baseline by 09:02:07 PT.
- Autoscaler triggered two ephemeral scale‑ups at 08:50:30 PT while error rate was high; CPU on the auth pod hit a 92% tail.
- KV cache miss ratio rose during the spike; we saw a brief cache eviction event at ~08:49:00 PT tied to a GC window.
- No customer‑facing rollout recorded in the cluster.

Attachments: auth-logs-20270607.zip (contains router logs, auth service traces), sanitized-kvcache-snippet.txt (cache hit/miss histogram)

Preliminary eligibility assessment: the failure is in our auth service path and produced 5xx responses for a continuous 15+ minute window. Per the MSA, that appears to meet the availability threshold for a partial remedy. Laura — please confirm contractual interpretation, but I'm comfortable moving forward with a draft pro‑rata credit.

Marissa
Incident Response Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Park <nicole.park@quartzpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AuthZ regression: request to validate failure window and credit eligibility

Hi Nicole — thanks again for the flag and the PDF. We completed the evidence pull and contract review. Summary and remedy below.

Impact window we validated: 2027‑06‑07 08:46:12 PT — 2027‑06‑07 09:02:07 PT (15m55s). Logs and traces attached (auth-logs-20270607.zip) and a sanitized cache histogram (sanitized-kvcache-snippet.txt).

Eligibility: After review against section 4.1 of the MSA, this outage meets the Availability SLO for the auth path and therefore qualifies for a pro‑rata billing adjustment. Laura confirmed legal review and sign‑off.

Proposed remedy: a pro‑rata credit equal to 0.6% of the invoice for the affected billing month. We arrived at 0.6% using the standard calculation in Appendix B (impact duration / monthly seconds). If that works for you, Finance will issue the credit to the account within the next billing cycle.

Next steps:
- I will share a short post‑incident note by Friday with root cause and corrective actions (KV cache GC tuning + autoscaler threshold change).
- Attached evidence bundle for your finance team: auth-logs-20270607.zip, sanitized-kvcache-snippet.txt
- If you need a formal statement or additional redactions, reply and we'll prioritize.

Link to internal incident: https://redwood.app/pm/INC-20270607-az

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: auth-logs-20270607.zip (attachment), sanitized-kvcache-snippet.txt (attachment)
